nodes.label: Append-Only Artwork Releases
nodes.rationale: Versioned objects are never overwritten, preserving reproducibility and enabling immutable caching.

nodes.label: Compact Canonical Scene Metadata
nodes.rationale: A compact checked-in mapping supplies corrected titles and anchors while canvases remain authoritative for image assignment and order.

nodes.label: Words-of-Jesus Ranges
nodes.rationale: Canonical VPL wording remains unchanged while official USFM markers contribute only verified speech ranges.

nodes.label: Dependency-Free Artwork Zoom
nodes.rationale: Native pointer events and CSS transforms provide mouse, keyboard, and touch inspection without adding a gesture library.
